visualCharacteristics: An infinitely looping carousel of linked image banners, showing two slides at a time with prev/next arrows, dots and 4-second autoplay.
contentPattern: One row per slide: a paragraph with a link wrapping a picture.
usage: Use to rotate a set of linked promotional image banners.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for image-only linked banner carousels; pick carousel when slides need text content.
